description: The Recipe Seeker — nutrition-first recipe site. Every indexable route is prerendered to static HTML at build time by scripts/prerender.mjs (custom SSG: vite SSR bundle + react-dom/server + react-helmet-async).
name: recipe-seeker-client

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
